games.description: Sark tries an abstract third-person shooter, follows the Robogo missions, and repeatedly challenges the brown-bot fortress before reaching the egg and a game-over screen.
games.title: 11th Dream

games.description: A brief solo experiment with a fractal-family symbol maker: Sark reads its unusual instructions, rearranges the boxes and words, and turns quitting the game into a mock speedrun.
games.title: 3 Households

games.description: A short VR first look at a sci-fi puzzle box. Sark wrestles with reversed controls, repeated resets, and colored orbs, then stops before making sense of the estate's loops.
A solo VR trial hampered by repeated freezes: Sark reaches the fisherman’s cabin tasks, tries a settings reset, then examines the concept trailer and gives his verdict.
games.title: A Fisherman's Tale

games.description: Sark follows an astronaut through a surreal sequence of parallel worlds, floating doubles, cosmic transitions, and dark gates during the April 20 stream.
games.title: Afterglitch

games.description: Two solo visits to Sejadasi’s surreal family puzzle game, later renamed STRANGERS. Sark investigates the household’s desires and experiments with time and relationships, then returns before broken interactions and save trouble stop the run.
games.title: DIVINITY

games.description: A solo test of the cryptic arena platformer. Sark experiments with charged jumps, gathers unusual objects and souls, tries to build structures, and finally consults the extensive manual.
games.title: Gardens of Celestial Globes

games.description: A short solo test of the surreal permadeath shooter. Sark adjusts the tiny game window, experiments with magic and movement, and makes repeated combat attempts while searching for health.
games.title: GOR3

games.description: An unfinished solo journey through the dream worlds. Sark steals the cave shard, solves the water-deity questions, explores the submerged research ruins and stops after meeting the hungry being with another fetch quest.
games.title: Hypnagogia: Boundless Dreams

aliases: Into the Dangerous World I Leapt
games.description: An unfinished solo journey through the surreal factory. Sark follows Idony’s missing-brother premise, flips between worlds and works on the courtyard and object puzzles, then stops at an unresolved bookcase and tooth search.
games.title: Into the Dangerous World I Leapt

games.description: A surreal point-and-click visit built around odd household objects, machines, a five-digit safe and symbolic rooms. Sark reaches the unfinished continuation screen before moving to another game.
games.title: Magnus Positive Phototaxis

games.description: Sark learns six-axis mech combat, survives the Wave of Death and tracks down Dad before taking the mission into space.
games.title: MECH PUNK

games.description: Sark retries the visual novel after a crash, reads its strange translated family story and then clicks through the remaining text to test its rapid achievement unlocks.
games.title: Once in Yaissor 3

games.description: Sark wanders through surreal nightmare spaces, crosses a flooded play room and searches a dark mansion with a dwindling lantern. A death appears to leave a locked-door progression problem, and he abandons the run after testing the remaining rooms.
games.title: Paranoya

games.description: Sark converses with the strange inhabitants of Gnostic cyber-hell through a microphone. Philosophical riddles, surreal masks and unreliable responses culminate in a freeze just short of the end.
games.title: Strange Aeons
